CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_team_access_from_source_rows(p_account jsonb, p_override jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((p_override->>'enabled')::boolean,false)
 AND COALESCE((p_override->>'allow_test_switch')::boolean,false)
 AND (p_override->>'test_expires_at')::timestamptz>p_at
 AND p_override->>'test_plan_code' IS NOT NULL
 THEN p_override->>'test_plan_code'='team'
 ELSE COALESCE(p_account->>'plan_code'='team' AND p_account->>'plan_source'='admin'
 AND p_account->>'billing_status'='none' AND p_account->>'entitlement_status' IN ('active','grace')
 AND ((p_account->>'entitlement_ends_at') IS NULL OR (p_account->>'entitlement_ends_at')::timestamptz>=p_at),false) END;
$function$
